mapper.select: /** * searchComboOptionRcivEq : isry.couns.taskwksprt.taskwkandatdmng.mapper.RcivEqptIndtyMapper : 수령장비구분코드 */ SELECT AA.CMMNS_CD_VALUE AS CD_VALUE , AA.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS CD_NAME FROM SAC100 AA WHERE 1=1 AND AA.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'RECPT_EQPMNT_SE_CD' /** 수령장비구분코드 **/

/** * selectUserInfo : isry.couns.taskwksprt.taskwkandatdmng.mapper.RcivEqptIndtyMapper : 로그인 정보 조회 */ SELECT T1.USER_ID AS USER_ID /* 상담원 아이디 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(T2.FLNM_ENCPT) AS FLNM /* 상담원 이름 */ , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AS WRT_YMD /* 현재 일자 */ , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SAB881 T3 /* 첨부파일상세 */ WHERE 1=1 AND T3.ATFINO = T2.ATFINO AND T3.FILE_STTS_SE_CD = 'N' AND T3.ATCMFL_CL_NM = '서명사진' ) AS ATCMFL_CNT /* 첨부파일 카운트 */ , T2.ATFINO AS ATFINO /* 첨부파일번호 */ , '서명사진' AS ATCMFL_CL_NM /* 첨부파일분류명 */ FROM SAA200 T1 /* 사용자 테이블 */ , SCA100 T2 /* 종사자 테이블 */ WHERE 1=1 AND T1.ENFSN_NO = T2.ENFSN_NO AND T1.USER_ID = #{loginId}

/** * selectRcivEqptIndtyList : isry.couns.taskwksprt.taskwkandatdmng.mapper.RcivEqptIndtyMapper : 기자재수령확인목록조회 */ WITH MAIN_DATA AS ( SELECT AA.INDEX_SN AS INDEX_SN , AA.RECEIV_ID AS CNSLTNT_ID , C##RG.DEC_B64(AA.RECEIV_NM_ENCPT) AS CNSLTNT_NM , TO_CHAR(AA.FRST_REG_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS EQPMNT_REG_YMD FROM AYC330 AA /** 사이버1388_장비 **/ , SAA200 BB , SCA100 CC WHERE 1=1 AND AA.DEL_YN = 'N' AND AA.RECEIV_ID = #{loginId} AND AA.RECEIV_ID = BB.USER_ID AND CC.ENFSN_NO = BB.ENFSN_NO ) SELECT LISTAGG(B2.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY 1) AS EQPMNT_ITEM_NM , MD.CNSLTNT_ID AS CNSLTNT_ID , MD.CNSLTNT_NM AS CNSLTNT_NM , MD.EQPMNT_REG_YMD AS EQPMNT_REG_YMD FROM AYC331 B1 , SAC100 B2 , MAIN_DATA MD WHERE 1=1 AND B1.RECPT_EQPMNT_CNFRMN_SN = MD.INDEX_SN AND B2.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'RECPT_EQPMNT_SE_CD' /** 수령장비구분코드 **/ AND B1.RECPT_EQPMNT_SE_CD = B2.CMMNS_CD_VALUE GROUP BY MD.INDEX_SN, MD.CNSLTNT_ID, MD.CNSLTNT_NM, MD.EQPMNT_REG_YMD ORDER BY MD.EQPMNT_REG_YMD DESC
mapper.insert:
/** * insertRcivEqptIndty1 : isry.couns.taskwksprt.taskwkandatdmng.mapper.RcivEqptIndtyMapper : 기자재수령확인 등록(AYC331 기자재 수령내역) */ INSERT INTO AYC331 AA /** 기자재수령내역 **/ ( RECPT_EQPMNT_CNFRMN_SN , RECPT_EQPMNT_SE_CD , DEL_YN , FRST_RGTR_ID , FRST_REG_DT , LAST_MDFR_ID , LAST_MDFCN_DT
) VALUES ( #{RECPT_EQPMNT_CNFRMN_SN} , #{eqpSeCd} , 'N' , #{loginId} , SYSDATE , #{loginId} , SYSDATE )
